pages.title: 1973 Oil Price Crisis and Strait of Hormuz disruption

facts.text: West Asia conflict disrupted oil flows through Strait of Hormuz — comparisons with 1973 Oil Crisis
facts.head: Why in news

facts.text: Trigger: Arab members of OPEC imposed oil embargo on countries supporting Israel in Yom Kippur War (1973)
facts.head: 1973 crisis

facts.text: First major use of oil as a geopolitical weapon; prices rose ~fourfold (~400%, 1973–74) → stagflation
facts.head: 1973 crisis

facts.text: Other factors: end of gold standard (1971); territories lost in 1967 war
facts.head: 1973 crisis

facts.text: Outcomes: petrodollar system; strategic petroleum reserves; creation of International Energy Agency (IEA)
facts.head: 1973 crisis

facts.text: ⚠ 1973 = political embargo; present crisis = physical disruption of supply routes
facts.head: 1973 crisis

facts.text: 1979 Oil Crisis — also caused stagflation (linked to Iranian Revolution, not OPEC price-stabilising cuts)
facts.head: 1973 crisis

facts.text: 1973: OAPEC embargo; prices $3 → $5+ (~70% initial rise); India's oil import bill $500 million (1973) → $1.3 billion (1974); inflation ~20%; Fifth Five-Year Plan assumptions upset
facts.head: How India handled 1973 and 1979 shocks

facts.text: 1979: Iranian Revolution; prices $13 (1979) → ~$34 (1980); India's BoP crisis → ⚠ approached IMF after 1979 (not 1973)
facts.head: How India handled 1973 and 1979 shocks

facts.text: India = third-largest crude consumer; coal ~48.4%, crude ~24.7% of energy demand (IEA)
facts.head: India's energy basket today

facts.text: Domestic crude meets ~13%; import dependence ~88.5% (FY26)
facts.head: India's energy basket today

facts.text: Strategic Petroleum Reserves: ~5.33 million tonnes capacity
facts.head: India's energy basket today

facts.text: Strait of Hormuz: between Iran and Oman (Musandam); links Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman; ~33 km at narrowest; ~one-fifth of global petroleum; Qatar LNG; ⚠ no direct link to Red Sea
facts.head: Straits — static GK

facts.text: Bab-el-Mandeb: Yemen and Djibouti/Eritrea — Red Sea ↔ Gulf of Aden
facts.head: Straits — static GK

facts.text: Bosphorus: within Turkey — Black Sea ↔ Sea of Marmara; Magellan: southern Chile
facts.head: Straits — static GK

facts.text: Connected to Red Sea: Gulf of Aden, Suez Canal, Bab-el-Mandeb
facts.head: Straits — static GK

facts.text: 2 × 1,200 MW = 2,400 MW — ~10% of power demand; VVER-1200 (Generation III+); core catcher, double containment

facts.text: Fission — splitting heavy nuclei; fusion — combining light nuclei (D-T), energy from mass defect (E = mc²)
